usage_notes: FLEXIBLE ASSET - not a fixed scene. Because it's isolated (plain/transparent background, no props), it can be resized up or down without breaking composition, layered next to or behind text, dropped into hero banners, used in interactive/animated components, or placed in a UI card without visual clutter competing with the copy. Treat this differently from the lifestyle photos below - those are meant to be shown as-is, this one is meant to be a building block.
